overview.description: What's waiting on you at {company}, then your numbers.

needsYou.title: Needs you

empty.title: Nothing needs you right now
empty.body: Applications to answer, drafts to review and live posts to pay appear here. Meanwhile, find a creator for your next campaign.

lowWallet.title: Wallet is at {amount}
lowWallet.body: Each invitation holds the creator's fee from your wallet, so a low balance blocks new ones.

signups.label: Attributed sign-ups
signups.hint: Tied to a creator's click by your pixel

explore.title: Browse creators
explore.body: Creators are ranked by fit with your brand. Each score shows the reasons behind it.

brief.title: Write your first brief
brief.body: Say what the post should do, who it's for and what to avoid. Creators write from it.

invite.title: Invite a creator
invite.body: The fee is held from your wallet until they accept. If they decline, it comes back to you.

collaborations.title: Collaborations
collaborations.description: Each row shows the next step and whose move it is.
collaborations.error: We couldn't load your collaborations. Your data is safe. Try again in a moment.

none.title: No collaborations yet
none.body: A collaboration starts when you invite a creator or accept an application. Start by finding a creator.

needsYou.title: Nothing needs you right now
needsYou.body: Everything open is with creators or finished.

waiting.title: Nothing is waiting on a creator
waiting.body: Invitations, drafts in progress and scheduled posts wait here while creators work on them.

done.title: Nothing finished yet
done.body: Paid and closed collaborations appear here.

all.title: No collaborations for this campaign
all.body: Invite a creator to this campaign, or look across all campaigns.

trail.totalTruncated: Latest {shown} of {count} rows. The CSV export has them all.

empty.clicks: Each click on a creator's tracked link appears here once their post is live.
empty.signups: Sign-ups appear here when your site pixel ties one to a click on a creator's link.
empty.spend: Each booking and payment appears here, starting with your first invitation.

results.title: Results
results.description: What your creators' posts brought in, traced back to each click.
results.error: We couldn't load your results. Your data is safe. Try again in a moment.

reach.hint: {count, plural, one {Estimate: sum of median views · # live post} other {Estimate: sum of median views · # live posts}}

signups.label: Attributed sign-ups
signups.hint: Tied to a creator's click by your pixel

pixel.title: Site pixel
pixel.inactive: Not installed yet. Add it to see the visits, sign-ups and purchases that follow each click.
pixel.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the snippet and copy it by hand.

dialog.title: Install the site pixel
dialog.body: Paste this snippet just before '</head>' on every page of your site. Visits are counted automatically. After a sign-up or purchase succeeds, call {global}('track', …) to send it.

attribution.title: By creator
attribution.description: Clicks on each creator's tracked link, then what your pixel saw after the click. Each row exports its own clicks.
attribution.empty: Once a creator's post is live, they appear here with their clicks and what your pixel saw after each one.

posts.title: Live posts
posts.description: Clicks on each post's tracked link. Reactions and comments are the creator's recent public-post averages; LinkedIn's numbers for the sponsored post aren't imported.
posts.empty: No live posts yet. Each post appears here once the creator publishes it, with the clicks on its link.

log.title: Click log
log.description: {count, plural, one {Latest {shown} of # click. The CSV has all of them.} other {Latest {shown} of # clicks. The CSV has all of them.}}

billing.title: Billing
billing.description: Where your money is, and every movement behind it.

held.hint: {count, plural, =0 {No invitations waiting on a reply} one {# invitation not answered yet · fee returned if declined} other {# invitations not answered yet · fees returned if declined}}

committed.label: Committed
committed.hint: {count, plural, =0 {No accepted collaborations yet} one {# accepted collaboration} other {# accepted collaborations}}

paid.label: Paid to creators
paid.hint: {count, plural, =0 {No posts paid yet} one {# paid post} other {# paid posts}}

topUp.title: Top up your wallet
topUp.description: Choose an amount. It's credited to your wallet as a ledger row.
topUp.suggested: Your balance doesn't cover this selection. The suggested amount does.

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.description: Every euro in or out, with its reference.
